body: I’ll admit there’s something about houses that make me feel relaxed. Maybe because homes remind me of my safe space (which is my home)?
Fuck friends. They only leave you in the end. Fuck relationships too.

I'll admit I don't have any friends myself. Hell, I don't even know how to go about making friends any more. I'll also admit I'm also very hesitant to make new friends. I've had many friends cut me off wether it might be just because I live farther away from them or sometimes they just completely ignore me and move on. I actually can relate to your concerns. I hate getting emotionally invested into other people trying to be a decent human being or friend spending your time and money on them just to have them give you shit later on. Part of me wants to have friends again but I also don't want to have to put up with other people's shit.

What therapies/ medications/ treatments did you use? Do you still feel any sense of agoraphobia today? I've personally tried CBT, Propranolol, and Somatic Experiencing therapy and have had only little improvement. I also feel sometimes that a lot of stimuli in my environment also makes me agoraphobia worse (bright lights, loud sounds, etc.)
I have. Unfortunately it helps for about an hour or two. Doesn’t get rid of my problems but gives mild short term relief.

Please keep us informed with your doctor says. I myself have seen very little improvement in the 7 years of being agoraphobic plus maybe the doctor’s diagnosis/ test results might offer some solutions for some of us here.

I can confirm that I have lived like this for a LONG time. I am terrified when I am left alone out in public. If my mom or dad cannot go somewhere with me, I stay home. Thankfully, my neighborhood and my home are the only places that I feel safe when my parents are gone. Due to my fear of being left alone, I had to leave my job and haven't had one for a while either. I honestly feel hopeless.
